outcome: Preterm birth across gestational age strata
cohort: The study included data on 328,879 live births and 1,470 fetal deaths that occurred in the state of Michigan between March and November from 2017 through 2020.
finding: The fetal death rate was significantly lower during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic in 2020 compared to prepandemic years, while the proportion of preterm births remained unchanged.
gest_age: <37 weeks' gestation (for preterm birth definition), stratified into <28, 28-31 6/7, 32-36 6/7, 37-41 6/7, and >42 weeks
